headline.zh: 为边缘设备选择 AI 推理方案
headline.en: Choose AI inference for edge devices

scenario.zh: 你正在为智能相机产品选型,需要在设备上运行实时物体检测模型
scenario.en: You're selecting hardware for smart cameras that run real-time object detection on device

instruction.zh: 确定首批设备数量和预算范围
instruction.en: Determine initial device volume and budget range

output.zh: 预算灵活,优先验证推理速度和功耗表现,可接受较高单价
output.en: Flexible budget prioritizing inference speed and power validation, higher unit cost acceptable

output.zh: 成本敏感,需要平衡性能与单价,供应链稳定性是关键考量
output.en: Cost-sensitive requiring performance-price balance, supply chain stability critical

instruction.zh: 根据检测需求选择模型参数规模
instruction.en: Choose model parameter scale based on detection requirements

output.zh: 闪存直读架构可完全加载模型,无需外部内存,降低物料成本
output.en: Flash-direct architecture loads full model without external memory, reducing BOM cost

output.zh: 模型容量需求较大,传统方案需增加DRAM,闪存方案保持成本优势
output.en: Larger capacity requirement needs added DRAM in traditional approach, flash maintains cost advantage

instruction.zh: 查看传统GPU内存架构与闪存直读架构的差异
instruction.en: Review differences between traditional GPU memory and flash-direct architecture

output.zh: 依赖高带宽内存实现推理,功耗较高,供应链受限于GPU厂商
output.en: Relies on high-bandwidth memory for inference, higher power draw, supply chain tied to GPU vendors

output.zh: 跳过内存瓶颈直接从闪存推理,容量扩展更经济,能效表现更优
output.en: Bypasses memory bottleneck with direct flash inference, more economical capacity scaling, superior efficiency

instruction.zh: 基于评估结果确定技术路线和时间表
instruction.en: Confirm technical direction and timeline based on evaluation

output.zh: 参与早期测试计划,为2028量产做准备,适合小批量试点场景
output.en: Join early testing program preparing for 2028 production, suitable for pilot scenarios

output.zh: 等待成熟供应链,降低技术风险,适合大规模部署需求
output.en: Wait for mature supply chain reducing technical risk, suitable for volume deployment

takeaway.zh: 闪存直读架构通过创新设计绕过传统内存瓶颈,为边缘AI推理提供更高容量和能效的选择
takeaway.en: Flash-direct architecture bypasses traditional memory bottlenecks through innovative design, offering higher capacity and efficiency for edge AI inference
